!!! note "A title that is never wrapped"
    The body of an
    admonition is
    wrapped to the
    width less its
    indentation, and its
    lines never start
    with !!! or ??? or
    \: that would change
    it.

Term
:   Details wrap inside
    their indentation
    as well, and
    \*&#91;HTML\]: lines
    stay text.
